interpretation.label: eligibility_trace_repair_validated
interpretation.route_note: Credit-eligibility windowing (ree-v3 93d5d98b80) holds the learned avoidance_efficacy above the pre-registered floor through the scoring window, where V3-EXQ-603u measured numerical zero (~1e-24..1e-29) on the identical config. The MECH-357 Stage-H instrument is repaired: the INTACT arm is no longer functionally lesioned where the DV is measured. substrate_queue mech357-avoidance-efficacy-eligibility-trace-imbalance failure_record target MET -> that failure_record may be resolved.

preconditions.name: ARM_INTACT_midline_pag_gate_combined_fix::ilpfc_gate_engages_and_suppresses_freeze
preconditions.description: The ilPFC gate must register efficacy updates under threat (n_credit+n_decay>0) AND suppress the PAG freeze (n_freeze_suppressed>0) on >= 2/3 seeds. Below floor => the gate never engaged, so the trace readout measures nothing => substrate_not_ready_requeue.
preconditions.control: Gate-ON arm with the protective-scaffold floor 0.8 annealing to 0.0.

preconditions.name: ARM_INTACT_midline_pag_gate_combined_fix::stage0_forced_feed_lights_zgoal
preconditions.description: Stage-0 forced supra-threshold benefit lights z_goal (>0.4) on >= 2/3 seeds -- the goal-FORMATION positive control, without which the agent never reaches a meaningful Stage-H.

preconditions.name: ARM_INTACT_midline_pag_gate_combined_fix::avoidance_trace_peak_nondegenerate
preconditions.description: SAME-STATISTIC positive control for C1 (the 643 rule): the LEARNED mech357_avoidance_efficacy -- the exact quantity C1 routes on, not a proxy -- must reach TRACE_PEAK_READY_FLOOR at SOME point in the Stage-H run on >= 2/3 seeds. V3-EXQ-603u cleared this on the BROKEN substrate (in-run peaks 0.659-0.970), so it is known-achievable and independent of the repair under test. Below floor => the learner never moved the trace at all => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a verdict about whether the repair worked.
preconditions.control: V3-EXQ-603u, same config, pre-fix: in-run peaks 0.659/0.936/0.832 (INTACT) and 0.894/0.964/0.971 (POSCTRL).
